Date: 2026-09-29T14:37:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Approval Request: Bundled Premium Onboarding + Integration (Veridian Health)

Thanks for the context. A few thoughts before I sign off: 

1) Precedent risk — including 80h of custom integration + waived onboarding sets a high bar for future deals. We should limit our exposure.
2) Engineering capacity — we can support the work, but only with a hard cap and clear acceptance criteria in the SOW. Recommend included scope = 60 hours; any additional work billed at $180/hr.
3) Discount — I can approve up to 20% off list for the first year given the strategic value. 25% requires Executive Finance approval (we need EBITDA impact review).
4) Contract changes — legal should approve an attachment limiting scope and adding a 30-day acceptance milestone for the integration deliverable.

Decision: Approve 20% first-year discount, include up to 60h of integration in the SOW, waive onboarding fee if we get a signed LOI within 5 business days. If the customer insists on 25% + 80h included, escalate to CFO (cc Marcus to coordinate).

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
